exercises.instruction: Choose the correct future perfect form.
exercises.prompt: By the time she gets home, I ___ dinner already.
exercises.hint: 'By the time' + two future events → the earlier one uses future perfect.
exercises.explanation: 'By the time she gets home' = a future reference point. Action completed before that → will have + V3.

exercises.hint: 'By 2030' = future deadline → completion before that point → future perfect.
exercises.explanation: 'By 2030' signals completion before a future deadline → will have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct form. Watch the V3.
exercises.prompt: Before the end of the year, she ___ all her debts.
exercises.hint: 'Before the end of the year' = deadline. 'will has' is always wrong — use 'will have'.
exercises.explanation: Future perfect: will have + V3. Never 'will has'. V3 of pay = paid.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct negative future perfect.
exercises.prompt: Don't come at 5pm — I ___ the report yet.
exercises.hint: Not completed by 5pm → won't have + V3.
exercises.explanation: Negative future perfect: won't have + V3. Completion will not occur before the deadline.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct future perfect question.
exercises.prompt: ___ you ___ all the chapters by the end of the week?
exercises.hint: Future perfect question: Will + subject + have + V3.
exercises.explanation: Will + subject + have + V3. V3 of read = read.

exercises.instruction: Watch the V3 form — not V2.
exercises.prompt: By the time you arrive, she ___ to Paris already.
exercises.hint: V3 of 'go' = gone (not 'went' which is V2). After 'will have', always use V3.
exercises.explanation: V2 = went, V3 = gone. Future perfect: will have + V3 → will have gone.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for: the future perfect form.
exercises.prompt: By Friday afternoon, the technicians ___ (install) the new system.
exercises.explanation: 'By Friday' = future deadline → will have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for:. Watch the irregular V3.
exercises.prompt: By the time the guests arrive, she ___ (write) 50 invitations.
exercises.explanation: V3 of write = written. Future perfect: will have + written.

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct answer for: the negative future perfect. Both 'won't have' and 'will not have' accepted.
exercises.prompt: I'm worried — by the deadline, we ___ (not / collect) enough data.
exercises.explanation: Negative future perfect: won't have / will not have + V3.

exercises.prompt: ___ (they / finish) construction by the time the president visits?
exercises.explanation: Future perfect question: Will + subject + have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Sebelum kamu tiba, saya sudah selesai memasak."
exercises.prompt: Sebelum kamu tiba, saya sudah selesai memasak.
options: By the time you arrive, I will has finished cooking.
By a time you arrive, I will have finished cooking.
By the time you arrive, I will finished cooking.
By the time you arrive, I will have finished cooking.
exercises.answer: By the time you arrive, I will have finished cooking.
exercises.explanation: Completion before a future event → will have + V3.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Dia tidak akan selesai proyek itu sebelum akhir bulan."
exercises.prompt: Dia tidak akan selesai proyek itu sebelum akhir bulan.
options: She won't has finished the project before the end of the month.
She won't have finished project before end of month.
She won't have finished a project before an end of a month.
She won't have finished the project before the end of the month.
exercises.answer: She won't have finished the project before the end of the month.
exercises.explanation: Negative future perfect: won't have + V3 before a deadline.

exercises.instruction: Translate into English: "Apakah kamu akan sudah menyelesaikan tugas itu pada hari Jumat?"
exercises.prompt: Apakah kamu akan sudah menyelesaikan tugas itu pada hari Jumat?
options: Will you have finished the assignment by Friday?
Will you has finished the assignment by Friday?
you Will have finished the assignment by Friday?
Will you have finished an assignment by Friday?
exercises.answer: Will you have finished the assignment by Friday?
exercises.explanation: Future perfect question: Will + subject + have + V3 + by [deadline].
